parsed.note_claim: Representatives of Dolly Parton's family announced that she passed after a brief battle with cancer.

parsed.quote: Dolly Parton, the beloved country superstar , was surrounded by loved ones when she died in Nashville after a brief bout with cancer, representatives said in a statement on Tuesday.
